title: Implement deterministic private Photo derivatives

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Private derivative tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_derivatives.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T3 verification passed the exact packaged-image mypy and focused private-derivative gates plus Memory Bank lint. A verifier-owned disposable MinIO probe proved exact two-kind repeat convergence, stable private keys/checksums, configured JPEG bounds, positive configuration validation, unchanged original, preserved sentinel, private topology, no delivery/logging/watermark/lifecycle expansion, exact cleanup and zero owned residue. Executor receipts remained supporting-only and were not reused.

Fresh adversarial review challenged pre-write and ambiguous post-write failure of the second derivative, retry/repeat convergence, invalid original handling, original/foreign state preservation, private delivery, and ownership/scope drift. Packaged probes passed; no material accepted-outcome break or operator-owned decision survived.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#deterministic-private-derivatives RED: processing has no owner-local deterministic preview/thumbnail boundary; GREEN: repeated creation over one synthetic Photo/revision produces exactly one bounded low-quality preview and thumbnail at stable private keys without rewriting the original; decisive comparison: artifact kinds, checksums, dimensions, repeat object count, private-boundary reads and forbidden-marker scans match while task-owned cleanup leaves zero residue; artifact: isolated derivative/object-store output and redacted marker scan.
purpose: Provide deterministic low-quality preview and thumbnail publication for one Photo/revision without exposing private commercial media.
success_outcome: Repeated derivative creation converges on one preview and thumbnail at deterministic private keys with configured bounds and no watermark or original rewrite.
anti_goals: Do not publish terminal processing state, presigned/browser storage URLs, watermarks or a cross-store transaction layer.
Do not introduce image variants, an artifact registry or cleanup lifecycle beyond the two required derivatives.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The derivatives cannot remain private behind the existing object-store boundary.
Correctness would require a distributed transaction, public MinIO access or another artifact lifecycle.

constraints: Use deterministic keys derived only from photo_id, pipeline_revision_id and artifact_kind.
Use task-owned synthetic commercial-photo bytes, object prefix, known initial state, safe repeat and owner-bounded cleanup.
MinIO and its keys stay private; logs and artifacts contain no credentials or commercial media.
invariants: Exactly one preview and one thumbnail kind exist per Photo/revision after repeat.
Originals are never rewritten and derivatives have no watermark.
No browser-facing path, response or log discloses object keys or credentials.
verification_targets: Isolated MinIO proof compares repeat checksums/keys, encoding bounds, privacy markers and zero task-owned residue.
